scope: 32 authored candidate requests, 16 parallel EN/IT pairs. Inputs and expected answers fixed before running either model. All successes and failures retained. Curated successful pairs are demonstrations, not a representative benchmark.
selection_rule: A pair qualifies for a variant only if both English and Italian choices match the expected labels. No prompt revisions based on predictions.
function_calling_scope: Model selects a function name only. Arguments come from synthetic application context; no argument extraction or tool execution is evaluated.
